RVC Fabric user guide

Learn about RVC real-time voice changer setup, hardware support, audio routing and Neptune branch features.

2026-11-07

Installation and first use

Download the installer from the official website. After installation, configure the runtime for your GPU and download or import a voice model. The installer size does not represent the disk space required after setup.

An internet connection is needed to download runtimes, models and updates. Once the required files are available, voice conversion runs locally. Check the license before using a third-party voice model.

System and hardware

The desktop application targets Windows 10 and Windows 11. NVIDIA GPUs use CUDA; AMD and Intel GPUs can use DirectML. Performance varies with the GPU, driver and model.

Voice training and real-time conversion have different hardware requirements. The current training interface requires an NVIDIA GPU. DirectML support for conversion does not imply support for the same training workflow.

Real-time latency depends on model inference, audio buffers, audio drivers and the receiving application. Check sound quality and stability through recording and an actual call after changing settings.

Connect QQ, Discord and OBS

After installing VB-Cable and restarting the computer, select your physical microphone as the input in RVC Fabric and CABLE Input as the output. Select a voice model and start conversion.

In QQ or Discord voice settings, select CABLE Output as the microphone or input device. In OBS, add an Audio Input Capture source and select CABLE Output.

Keep your headphones as the Windows default playback device. For local monitoring, select headphones so that monitored audio is not fed back into the input. Check the level meter, then record a short sample.

  • VB-Cable documentation
  • OBS sources guide

Choosing an RVC tool

RVC is a voice conversion technology used by multiple applications. RVC Fabric provides a Windows desktop interface, runtime setup, model management and audio tools for users who need these functions in one application.

When comparing RVC Fabric, RVC WebUI and w-okada voice-changer, first check the operating system, live or file conversion needs, model formats and hardware requirements. Then test with the same audio and model. Consult the documentation for each specific version.

  • RVC WebUI repository
  • w-okada voice-changer repository

Neptune branch

As of November 7, 2026, the Neptune branch includes mobile pairing, a local API and an MCP interface. Mobile pairing captures audio on the phone and performs voice conversion on the desktop. Check the release notes to determine whether a downloaded build includes these branch features.

  • Local API and MCP guide
